challenge.better_approach: The refusal commits its own records: that puts git commits (and then pushes, or the_stones_are_pushed reds next) inside the ticket machine on every refusal, on whichever box asked. Not counting the dialog that this very crossing chain wrote is smaller and leaves commit cadence with the builder.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That append-only can be read cheaply: git show HEAD:<path> is a prefix of the working copy, and each extra line parses as a gate_dialog for T (log) or a journal entry naming T's log path. A rewritten line or a non-dialog kind keeps the path dirty.
challenge.prior_art: 12443bcc113f (another ticket's records stop blocking, waits on Q#94) keeps the crossing ticket's own records refusing, its clause 4, so Q#94's answer does not cover this: this is the narrower append-only gate-dialog case of the ticket's OWN records. c1cca2e3dc23 (8w) widened the sieve to catch orphaned WORK (3fef5a02da2d's lab lines); a gate's own dialog line is the crossing's record, not work. history_integrity already compares working copy against git show HEAD:<path>, a pattern to reuse.
challenge.real_collision: Not exclusive with 8w: its why is loose work no commit holds, and the dialog line records a crossing, not work. Recorded as a distinction; if the outline check finds Q#94 in its section, it will bind.

answers.falsifier: RED if T's own appended gate_dialog lines (and their journal lines) still refuse T's next crossing; or if any other appended line, an edit to those files, or any other dirty path stops refusing.
answers.from_idea: none, because the orchestrator relayed it from 3195b3b834bc's log, CairnCommons/tickets/3195b3b834bc-a-far-bus-handle-s-flush-answers-without-asking-the-lan-door-for-an-op-it-refuse.log.jsonl, gate_dialog lines at 2026-11-12T21:21:33, 21:22:02 and 21:22:29
answers.how: working_tree_clean, judged for a crossing ticket T, compares each dirty path against HEAD; a path whose only change is appended lines that are T's own gate_dialog log lines (tickets/T-*.log.jsonl) or the artifact journal's lines for that log is not dirt. Any other change in those files, and every other path, still refuses. The crossing ticket is threaded from transitions.py's PROVEME/PROVED callers. Red-first proof over scratch repos.
answers.traces_to: Law 8 (a crossing still refuses over loose code or work: the cut is the gate's own dialog only) and Law 1 (a commit between a refusal and its re-cross records nothing new and costs a full gate round per refusal).
answers.what: A refused crossing's own gate-dialog record never refuses the same ticket's next crossing, so a ticket re-crosses after a refusal without a commit in between.

bullets.text: 3195 on the Dell: PROVED refused at 21:21:33 (not pushed); the push re-cross at 21:22:02 refused on working_tree_clean, dirty_count 2 = the refusal's own log.jsonl line and journal line; a commit, then 21:22:29 crossed. Every refusal costs a commit before the next try.
